body.p:
AI Positron contributes AI actions in Web Author's file comparison tool to explain file comparison differences . With AI Positron installed, the header of the Differences side view in the file comparison tool contains the following buttons:
Explain Differences - The AI assistant explains the differences for the entire document.
Explain Current Block of Differences - The AI assistant explains the differences in the current block of content.You can also ask the AI to explain differences or how to resolve conflicts directly in the chat input box in the AI Positron view.
